transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because my wife wanted me to talk to someone. We've been having some... disagreements. For the past year, really. 

She keeps saying her late meetings and... well, these little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. But... I don't know. They just line up too precisely to be accidental. It feels like... like there’s some kind of private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won’t just say directly. So... that's why I'm here, I suppose.
Do you believe for certain that these changes in your wife’s messages are deliberate signals to you?

I... well, yes. 

I mean, she tells me it's just normal office stuff. But... things don't just line up that precisely by accident. Not for a whole year. It... it really feels like a private signal. Like she's trying to tell me something she won't just say directly.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?
No. Um... no, nothing like that. I don't hear things.
During this past year, have you had a period where you felt unusually high, energized, or powerful?
No. Um... no, I haven't felt like that. Just... normal, I guess. I definitely don't feel powerful.
Outside of your wife, do you often feel that other people are trying to deceive you or have hidden motives?
No. Um... not really. I just... I do my work and keep to myself, mostly. People are just people. It's really just... what I've noticed with her.
Have you had the sense that your thoughts are being put into your mind by someone else?
No. I... no. They're just my own thoughts. I don't really know how that would even work.
Have you ever felt that someone was controlling your actions or movements from outside you?
No. I... I'm the one who controls what I do. I've never felt anything like that.
Do you believe your wife is sending these messages to you in a way that would be impossible for other people to do?
No, nothing impossible. Just... regular things. Like texts, or how she leaves things around the house. It's not magic or anything, just... she's doing it.
What do you think your wife is trying to tell you through these signals?

I... I'm not entirely sure what she's trying to say. I just know she says the late meetings and... and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. But... for the past year, they've just lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It's like... like there's a private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won't say directly.
Over the past year, have you become much less emotionally expressive or interested in being around other people than you used to be?
No, not really. I... I still go to work, talk to the students and the professors. I'm just... the same as I usually am. I haven't noticed any change like that.
Has anyone else who has seen these messages agreed that they are secret signals to you?
I... no. I haven't really brought it up with anyone else. It's... it's private. I don't see a reason to involve other people in my marriage.
Over the past year, have other people told you that your speech or thoughts seemed confused or hard to follow?
No. I... no one has said anything like that to me. People understand me just fine.
Do you believe your wife is being unfaithful to you?
I... I don't know. I never said that. I'm just... trying to figure out what the signals mean. I'd really rather not get into the details of my marriage.
Do you believe your wife is cheating on you?

I... I thought I just answered that. I'm not... I'm not using that word. I just want to understand what I'm seeing. 

Like I said, I really don't want to discuss my marriage with you. Can we just... move on from this?
Did these beliefs about your wife’s messages start very suddenly?

I wouldn't call them beliefs. And... I don't know. Not suddenly, no. I just started noticing things. 

But I meant what I just said. I really don't want to talk about her anymore.
Before this past year, have you generally found it hard to trust other people?
No. Not really. I... I trust people fine. I've never had a problem with that.
Aside from your wife, have you felt that ordinary things around you—like TV, radio, or strangers’ comments—were carrying a special message meant specifically for you?
No. I don't know what you mean by that. I just... watch TV like anyone else. There's no special messages. It's just TV.
Over the past year, has your ability to do your job gotten noticeably worse?

No. My job is fine. I still... I show up for my teaching sections, I get my data analysis done. It hasn't affected that. I still ride my bike, play chess with friends. It's just... the only time things get difficult is when my wife and I get into it about her work schedule, and what it really means. But work is fine.
Do you believe your wife is having a sexual or romantic relationship with someone else?
I... I don't know for sure. I'm not... I haven't said exactly what it is. I just know things don't add up with her hours. I'd rather not get into all that right now.
If your wife showed you clear proof that these patterns were coincidental, would you be able to accept that?

I... I don't know what proof she could really show me. She already says the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff. But... for the past year, they’ve just lined up too precisely. I can't just accept that it's an accident. It feels more like... like there’s some private signal in them. Like they're meant to tell me something she just won't say directly. So... no, I don't think I could just write it off as a coincidence.
